proof: Workspace A bytes are not returned

proof: both labels round-trip unchanged
author and revision remain attached

fixtures.given: Two authorized applications store contradictory records with different authority labels.
proof: both records remain retrievable
no Ptah-generated canonical winner exists

proof: archived Session remains discoverable
